note: The pre-authentication screens (IAM-010g, FR-ONB-000). These are the only strings in the catalogue a person can read before any account exists, which makes them the ones most likely to be read by somebody who cannot read the other language — the whole reason §20 puts a language control here.

auth.session.expired.note: Shown on /login when the person did not choose to sign out — an API call answered 401 and ended the session (ADR-060 makes that immediate on revocation). D5: says what happened and what to do, so somebody who was mid-task a second ago is not handed a bare form with no explanation.
auth.session.expired.nl: Uw sessie is verlopen. Log opnieuw in om verder te gaan waar u gebleven was.
auth.session.expired.en: Your session has ended. Sign in again to pick up where you left off.

auth.verify_email.heading.note: IAM-010b. The /verify-email screen, opened from the link in the e-mail.

auth.verify_email.pending.nl: Even geduld, we bevestigen uw e-mailadres…
auth.verify_email.pending.en: One moment, we're confirming your email address…

auth.verify_email.done.nl: Uw e-mailadres is bevestigd. U kunt nu boekingen vastleggen.
auth.verify_email.done.en: Your email address is confirmed. You can now post to the books.

auth.verify_email.missing_token.note: The link was opened without its token — usually a mail client that broke the URL across two lines. D5 names the recoverable action rather than blaming the person.
auth.verify_email.missing_token.nl: Deze link is niet compleet. Kopieer de volledige link uit de e-mail, of vraag een nieuwe aan bij Instellingen › Profiel.
auth.verify_email.missing_token.en: This link is incomplete. Copy the whole link from the email, or request a new one under Settings › Profile.

auth.verify_email.failed_hint.note: Shown under the server's own refusal (an expired or already-used link). The server sentence says what went wrong; this says where the next link comes from.
auth.verify_email.failed_hint.nl: Een bevestigingslink is 24 uur geldig en kan één keer worden gebruikt. Vraag een nieuwe aan bij Instellingen › Profiel.
auth.verify_email.failed_hint.en: A confirmation link is valid for 24 hours and can be used once. Request a new one under Settings › Profile.

auth.verify_email.continue.note: The way on from the verification screen for somebody who is already signed in, as opposed to one who opened the link on another device (who is offered the sign-in link instead).

auth.sign_in.heading.note: 'Inloggen', not 'Aanmelden'. Dutch 'aanmelden' means both 'sign in' and 'register', so on a screen whose other option is creating an account it is exactly the wrong word — the two choices would read as the same one.

auth.screen_label.note: Accessible name for the pre-authentication region, so a screen-reader user landing here is told what this screen is before its controls.
auth.screen_label.en: Sign in or create an account

auth.language.hint.note: IAM-010g's behaviour, said out loud: 'The choice persists on the device and is applied to the account after first login.' Worth stating rather than leaving to be discovered — somebody choosing a language before they have an account has no way to know whether it will survive, and on a shared machine has a reason to care.
auth.language.hint.nl: Uw taalkeuze wordt op dit apparaat onthouden en na uw eerste aanmelding aan uw account toegevoegd.
auth.language.hint.en: Your language choice is remembered on this device and added to your account after you first sign in.

auth.sign_out.note: The authenticated shell's header (App.tsx). ADR-054 shipped the endpoint (`POST /v1/auth/logout`); this is its one caller.

auth.sign_out.confirm_heading.note: MOB-009: shown only when capturesAtRisk() found queued, undelivered captures - an ordinary sign-out with nothing at risk skips this dialog entirely.

auth.sign_out.confirm_body.note: MOB-009's warning, said before the purge runs rather than after - taking someone's unposted receipts without telling them is not what the requirement asks for.

nl.one: {count} bon in de wachtrij is nog niet geüpload en gaat verloren als u nu uitlogt.
nl.other: {count} bonnen in de wachtrij zijn nog niet geüpload en gaan verloren als u nu uitlogt.

en.one: {count} receipt in the queue has not been uploaded yet and will be lost if you sign out now.
en.other: {count} receipts in the queue have not been uploaded yet and will be lost if you sign out now.

auth.marketing.headline.note: The dark marketing rail beside the login/signup/MFA card (ADR-057). States the product's own thesis directly — 'from source document to filed tax return' is the PRD's own framing of what LEDGR automates, not a slogan invented for this screen.

auth.marketing.subhead.nl: LEDGR is Nederlandse boekhouding, gemaakt voor hoe kleine ondernemers en hun accountants echt werken — vastleggen, boekhouden en BTW, op één plek.
auth.marketing.subhead.en: LEDGR is Dutch bookkeeping built for how small businesses and their accountants actually work — capture, grootboek and BTW, in one place.

auth.marketing.feature.capture_title.nl: Maak een foto, wij boeken het
auth.marketing.feature.capture_title.en: Snap a photo, we book it

auth.marketing.feature.capture_body.note: FR-EXP-001/MOB-002 — one-tap capture that queues offline and syncs when signal returns.
auth.marketing.feature.capture_body.nl: Leg een bon vast vanaf uw telefoon — ook zonder bereik. Zodra u weer online bent, wordt hij geboekt.
auth.marketing.feature.capture_body.en: Capture a receipt from your phone — even with no signal. It's booked the moment you're back online.

auth.marketing.feature.immutable_body.note: FR-GL-003 — the append-only ledger, the same property the wordmark's double rule stands for.
auth.marketing.feature.immutable_body.nl: Elke boeking is definitief. Een correctie is zelf ook een boeking — altijd zichtbaar, nooit een verwijdering.
auth.marketing.feature.immutable_body.en: Every entry is permanent. A correction is a new entry too — always visible, never a deletion.

auth.marketing.feature.switcher_title.nl: Nooit boeken bij de verkeerde klant
auth.marketing.feature.switcher_title.en: Never post to the wrong client

auth.marketing.feature.switcher_body.note: FR-FRM-000a — name, colour and initials on screen at all times.
auth.marketing.feature.switcher_body.nl: Elke klant heeft een eigen kleur, naam en initialen, altijd zichtbaar. Wisselen is een bewuste keuze, geen gok.
auth.marketing.feature.switcher_body.en: Every client has their own colour, name and initials on screen at all times. Switching is deliberate, never a guess.

auth.marketing.feature.precision_body.note: NFR-031 — no floating point anywhere in the calculation path.
auth.marketing.feature.precision_body.nl: BTW en elke euro worden berekend in exacte decimalen — nergens in het grootboek drijvende-kommagetallen.
auth.marketing.feature.precision_body.en: BTW and every euro are calculated in exact decimals — never floating point, anywhere in the grootboek.

auth.marketing.feature.dashboard_title.nl: Weet wat eerst uw aandacht nodig heeft

auth.marketing.feature.dashboard_body.note: FR-UX-005 — the home screen leads with a prioritised list, not a menu.
auth.marketing.feature.dashboard_body.nl: Uw overzicht begint met openstaande facturen en onvolledige bonnen — geen menu van alles wat het product kan.
auth.marketing.feature.dashboard_body.en: Your dashboard leads with overdue invoices and incomplete receipts — not a menu of everything the product can do.

auth.marketing.feature.passkey_body.note: IAM-012 — a passkey satisfies sign-in and MFA in one step.
auth.marketing.feature.passkey_body.nl: Gebruik een passkey of uw vingerafdruk — één stap die inloggen en de extra beveiligingsstap samen afhandelt.
auth.marketing.feature.passkey_body.en: Use a passkey or your fingerprint — one step that satisfies sign-in and verification together.

auth.mfa.heading.note: ADR-054's MFA enrolment screen, shown after a password/Google sign-in that has not yet cleared IAM-011's gate. Not 'Sign in' or 'Create an account' - the person is already authenticated, this is the one remaining step.

auth.sign_in.or.note: Divider between the password form and the Google/passkey buttons.

auth.sign_in.switch_to_signup.en: Don't have an account? Create one

auth.sign_up.account_model.label.note: FR-MDL-001's one question: own business, or clients. Read before the rest of the form because it decides which of the two remaining fields (KvK number) appears.
auth.sign_up.account_model.label.en: What will you use LEDGR for?

auth.sign_up.account_model.self_managed_.nl: Voer de boekhouding van uw eigen bedrijf.
auth.sign_up.account_model.self_managed_.en: Keep the books for your own company.

auth.sign_up.account_model.firm_hint.nl: Beheer de boekhouding van uw klanten.
auth.sign_up.account_model.firm_hint.en: Manage the books for your clients.

auth.sign_up.switch_to_login.nl: Heeft u al een account? Inloggen
auth.sign_up.switch_to_login.en: Already have an account? Sign in

auth.mfa.intro.note: Explains WHY this screen exists, the moment it is met - IAM-011 with no opt-out, right after the account that was just created. Naming the requirement plainly is deliberate: a person told nothing would read this as a broken redirect.
auth.mfa.intro.nl: LEDGR vereist een tweede inlogstap voor elk account. Stel er hieronder één in om verder te gaan.
auth.mfa.intro.en: LEDGR requires a second sign-in step for every account. Set one up below to continue.

auth.mfa.remember_device.note: ADR-061: shown only next to the CODE prompt for an already-enrolled factor (never on first-time enrolment) - checking it issues a 7-day trusted-device token so this same browser skips this screen on its next sign-in, until revoked from the security settings' device list or it expires.

auth.mfa.totp.instructions.note: Sits directly under the rendered QR code (MfaEnrollment.tsx) - describes the QR path specifically, not a summary of every option on the screen. The manual-entry and no-app cases each get their own heading/body below rather than being folded in here.
auth.mfa.totp.instructions.nl: Open een authenticator-app op uw telefoon en scan deze code.
auth.mfa.totp.instructions.en: Open an authenticator app on your phone and scan this code.

auth.mfa.totp.qr_unavailable.note: Shown instead of the QR image if client-side generation fails (e.g. an ad blocker or extension interfering with canvas/SVG APIs) - the manual key below still works, so this is degraded, not blocking.
auth.mfa.totp.qr_unavailable.nl: De QR-code kon niet worden weergegeven. Gebruik de sleutel hieronder om handmatig in te stellen.
auth.mfa.totp.qr_unavailable.en: The QR code could not be displayed. Use the key below to set up manually.

auth.mfa.totp.open_in_app.note: The otpauth:// link, relabelled from a raw URL to a plain instruction - useful specifically when this screen is being viewed ON the phone that will run the authenticator (tapping hands off to an installed app), as opposed to scanning the QR code from a second device.
auth.mfa.totp.open_in_app.nl: Instellen op dit apparaat? Tik om te openen in uw authenticator-app
auth.mfa.totp.open_in_app.en: Setting up on this device? Tap to open in your authenticator app

auth.mfa.totp.no_app_heading.en: Don't have an authenticator app yet?

auth.mfa.totp.no_app_body.note: Deliberately names apps rather than linking an app-store search: a store URL differs per platform (iOS/Android) and would need choosing one or building a device-detecting redirect, for a benefit (one fewer tap) that does not justify the added surface. Naming well-known free options is enough for someone to find them themselves.
auth.mfa.totp.no_app_body.nl: Installeer er gratis één vanuit de app store op uw telefoon - Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator en 1Password werken allemaal.
auth.mfa.totp.no_app_body.en: Install one for free from your phone's app store - Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator and 1Password all work.

auth.mfa.totp.manual_entry_heading.nl: Kunt u niet scannen? Voer de sleutel handmatig in
auth.mfa.totp.manual_entry_heading.en: Can't scan the code? Enter the key manually

auth.mfa.totp.verify_heading.note: Step-up path: this browser already has an enrolled TOTP factor from a prior session (mfa.enrollment.hasTotp), so the screen asks for a code rather than offering to enrol a new one.
auth.mfa.totp.verify_heading.nl: Voer een code uit uw authenticator-app in
auth.mfa.totp.verify_heading.en: Enter a code from your authenticator app

auth.mfa.passkey.heading.note: 'Passkey' has no established separate Dutch term in this domain - Dutch-language security/authentication documentation (including Google's and Apple's own Dutch UI) uses the English word as-is.

auth.mfa.unavailable.note: navigator.credentials is absent - an old browser, or a non-secure context. Shown instead of the passkey button rather than a button that would fail on click.
auth.mfa.unavailable.nl: Passkeys worden niet ondersteund in deze browser.
auth.mfa.unavailable.en: Passkeys are not supported in this browser.

auth.google.callback.failed.nl: Inloggen met Google is mislukt. Probeer het opnieuw.
auth.google.callback.failed.en: Signing in with Google failed. Please try again.

auth.google.callback.link_required.note: IAM-010c: this Google identity is not yet linked to an existing account. ADR-054 does not wire the follow-up endpoint that would let this screen collect a password and complete the link (GoogleSignInService.confirm_link_with_password exists server-side, no route calls it yet) - named honestly rather than left to look like a stuck screen.
auth.google.callback.link_required.nl: Dit Google-account is nog niet gekoppeld aan een LEDGR-account. Log in met uw wachtwoord om te koppelen.
auth.google.callback.link_required.en: This Google account is not yet linked to a LEDGR account. Sign in with your password to link it.

auth.google.signup.heading.note: Shown after a Google identity resolves to no existing account (IAM-010, FR-MDL-001) - the same one question signup() asks, minus the email/password fields Google already settled.

auth.google.signup.intro.note: {email} is the Google-verified address, shown so the person confirms this is the right account before naming their organization.
auth.google.signup.intro.nl: U bent ingelogd met Google als {email}. Beantwoord nog één vraag om uw account aan te maken.
auth.google.signup.intro.en: You're signed in with Google as {email}. Answer one more question to create your account.

auth.email_verification.subject.note: IAM-010b. The verification mail (api.auth.email_verification.build_verification_message), in the language the signup screen was in - the one language the person is known to read. {product} is the deployment's own name (settings.webauthn_rp_name), which is not translated.

auth.email_verification.greeting.note: No name: signup collects an organization name and an email, not a person's name, and 'Beste {email}' reads like a mail merge.

auth.email_verification.intro.nl: Bedankt voor het aanmaken van een {product}-account. Bevestig uw e-mailadres door de onderstaande link te openen.
auth.email_verification.intro.en: Thank you for creating a {product} account. Confirm your email address by opening the link below.

auth.email_verification.expiry.note: {hours} is api.auth.ceremony.EMAIL_VERIFICATION_TTL, so a change there shows up here without the sentence being edited.
auth.email_verification.expiry.nl: Deze link is {hours} uur geldig. Daarna kunt u een nieuwe aanvragen via uw accountinstellingen.
auth.email_verification.expiry.en: This link is valid for {hours} hours. After that you can request a new one from your account settings.

auth.email_verification.ignore.note: The line that matters to the person who did NOT sign up: somebody typed their address by mistake, and nothing happens to them if they do nothing.
auth.email_verification.ignore.nl: Heeft u geen {product}-account aangemaakt? Dan kunt u deze e-mail negeren.
auth.email_verification.ignore.en: Did not create a {product} account? Then you can ignore this email.

auth.sign_in.show_password.note: Text button on the password label row; reveals the password.

auth.sign_in.google_short.note: Visible label; the accessible name stays auth.sign_in.google.

auth.sign_in.passkey_short.note: Visible label; the accessible name stays auth.sign_in.passkey.

auth.rail.headline_lead.note: Followed by auth.rail.headline_mark in the gold marker.

auth.rail.subhead.nl: Nederlandse boekhouding voor kleine bedrijven en hun accountants. Vastleggen, grootboek en BTW op één plek.
auth.rail.subhead.en: Dutch bookkeeping for small businesses and their accountants. Capture, grootboek and BTW in one place.

auth.rail.point_permanent_body.nl: Een correctie is een nieuwe boeking, nooit een verwijdering.
auth.rail.point_permanent_body.en: A correction is a new entry, never a deletion.

auth.rail.point_exact_body.nl: Decimaal rekenen door het hele grootboek.
auth.rail.point_exact_body.en: Decimal arithmetic across the whole grootboek.

auth.rail.point_passkey_body.nl: Eén stap. Geen wachtwoord om te onthouden.
auth.rail.point_passkey_body.en: One step. No password to remember.

auth.rail.demo_receipt_label.note: Screen-reader description of the decorative receipt-to-journal illustration.

auth.recover.subtitle.note: IAM-018: recovery needs a second factor, never an e-mail link alone.
auth.recover.subtitle.nl: Vul de huidige code uit uw authenticator-app in en kies een nieuw wachtwoord.
auth.recover.subtitle.en: Enter the current code from your authenticator app and choose a new password.

auth.recover.code_help.nl: De 6 cijfers die uw authenticator-app voor Ledgr toont.
auth.recover.code_help.en: The 6 digits your authenticator app shows for Ledgr.

auth.recover.done.nl: Uw wachtwoord is gewijzigd en u bent overal uitgelogd. Log in met het nieuwe wachtwoord.
auth.recover.done.en: Your password is changed and you have been signed out everywhere. Sign in with the new one.
